description: This PHP source file defines the ConfigSingleImportForm class for importing a single configuration file in Drupal. It includes methods for form creation, validation, and submission, handling configuration import logic with validation and batch processing.

classes.name: ConfigSingleImportForm
classes.description: A Drupal form class for importing a single configuration file, handling user confirmation, validation, and batch import processing.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates an instance of the form using dependency injection from the container.

methods.name: getCancelUrl
methods.description: Returns the URL to cancel the form and go back to the import page.

methods.name: getQuestion
methods.description: Generates the confirmation question based on whether the config exists or is new.

methods.name: buildForm
methods.description: Builds the configuration import form with options for config type, name, import data, and advanced settings.

methods.name: validateForm
methods.description: Validates the import data, checks for existing entities, and validates changes via ConfigImporter.

methods.name: submitForm
methods.description: Handles form submission, initiating batch import if confirmed.
